name: URL in, instant analysis card out
looks: A cursor clicks into a plain pill-shaped URL field, a domain types in, and the cursor presses a bold accent 'Analyze' button. A dark pill reading a live scan status (which sources, how many found) holds briefly, then a clean result card pops up: an app icon and name, a one-line description, an audience line and a row of topic tags, with a cursor-clicked approve button in the corner.
build: The field and button are plain white DOM cards on a cream ground; the cursor path is power3.inOut with a 0.045s press scale-down and 0.14s release (glass-ui-flow's cursor mechanic). The scan pill's thread count is a live readout (kit.setText, no easing). The result card's rows stagger in top to bottom, tags landing last on a short scale-pop.
sound: A soft click on each cursor press, a light tick under the scan pill's counting, and a confirm chime as the result card settles.
prompt: Show a product turn one input into a finished answer in seconds: a cursor types a single value into a plain field and presses one button, a brief live-status pill shows real work happening, then a clean summary card pops up naming what was found, who it is for and a few tags, ready to approve.
